topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I stepped out into the yard, the air crisp and carrying whispers of change. There, where the youngest branch used to wave hello, now lies a quiet space, a patch of earth more open to the sky. The stump is a round table of memories, each ring a chapter of years long gone. I trace the ridges with my fingers, feeling the stories inside the wood. A gentle shift in the breeze stirs the leaves that still linger, and I realize the tree may be gone, but the forest of moments we shared remains, vast and deep within me.
